method: All graph edges; five uniform source phases including window endpoints; exact original accessor tracks sampled at 120Hz through runtime blend; native and requested game speeds; source clips key times plus120Hz; joint origins and sole corners; default bounded0.12m lift.

profiles.scope: Exact source GLB rotations/translations, canonical joint origins and conservative sole-corner proxies; excludes skinned mesh, contact IK, ball collision, and unsampled time/phase/rate combinations. Speed-forbidden edges are additionally measured at the defensive capped rate and marked speedPermitted=false; the runtime rejects those requests.
